TICKET-121.title: Gateway Timeout Failure on VPN Port 52fd
TICKET-121.description: User connection dropped with gateway unreachable timeout
TICKET-121.resolution_steps:
Relevant historical insights from matched ticket #TICK-102 (Cisco AnyConnect VPN Connection Timeout (Gateway Unreachable)):
1. Examine shared diagnostic telemetry matching VPN_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_FAILURE_PORT.
2. Apply preliminary recovery actions proven in ticket #TICK-102:
   • 1. Restart Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Agent service (`net stop csc_vpnagent && net start csc_vpnagent`)
   • 2. Reset Windows Socket stack and flush DNS cache (`netsh winsock reset && ipconfig /flushdns`)
3. Verify if target services restore normal latency; if persistent, proceed with human verification.
